jobs.occupation: Automation Engineer - Project Execution und Product Development (all genders welcome) (Ingenieur/in - Batterietechnik)
jobs.description:
Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy – a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

You will be part of our global Automation organization and play a key role in the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of automation standards for electrolysis projects, including green hydrogen (AWE), chlor-alkali and HCl electrolysis technologies.
Your role involves assuming responsibility for defined engineering work packages to support parallel project execution and enhance delivery reliability and throughput as well as responsibility for complete automation scopes during various phases of project execution.
Your tasks:

- Acting as a technical lead for automation topics within projects executed by our global automation team
- Performing basic and detail engineering for control and safety systems, including architecture design, hardware planning and software concepts
- Supporting technical procurement, supplier clarification and evaluation of automation components and systems
- Preparing and supporting Factory Acceptance Tests, including coordination with suppliers and alignment within our global automation team
- Providing support for installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities for automation systems at construction sites worldwide, primarily through short-term assignments (remote and on-site, as required)
- Serving as a key technical interface within our global automation organization and other global stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with internal standards, project-specific requirements, functional safety and IT/OT security guidelines
- Creating and reviewing technical documentation using database-based and engineering IT tools
- Actively sharing knowledge and best practices and mentoring junior engineers
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our automation solutions
- Contribute to the development, maintenance and evolution of standardized automation solutions
- Drive modularization, reusability and productization of automation assets to support scalable and future-proof solutions

Profil

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable technical discipline
- Several years of professional experience in automation engineering for industrial or process plants, preferably in chemical or electrolysis plant engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with industrial automation systems and hardware, including SAS and PLC platforms from leading manufacturers
- Strong understanding of automation system architectures
- Interest or experience in new automation technologies, digitalization, simulation or advanced engineering methods is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of network and fieldbus technologies (e.g. Profinet, Modbus TCP)
- Experience or strong understanding of functional safety and IT/OT security concepts in industrial environments
- Ability to work independently and structured, with a strong sense of ownership for technical results and quality
- Proven capability to work in international and intercultural teams
- Very good English und German communication skills, both written and verbal (min. C1)
- Willingness to travel internationally for short-term assignments
- Natural inclination to coach and support less experienced colleagues, acting as a role model within the team

Das bieten wir

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal und Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.
- We offer further training and support in line with your individual strengths and goals in order to optimally accompany your career path.
- In intercultural and interdisciplinary teams, communication at eye level is our top priority.
- Flexitime, part-time, home office, mobile working abroad: whenever possible, we give you the flexibility you want for your work.
- For the perfect office days, we provide state-of-the-art equipment at our global locations as well as quiet and communal areas for every situation.
- For a potential move to a location near the office, we will support your relocation organizationally and financially - also internationally.
- Your personal business buddy will be at your side during your induction - so new starters quickly get to know the company, the department and their colleagues.
- If that's not enough for you: by working on green hydrogen technologies, we are ensuring clean energy for the future. Be a part of it: new era is you.

Kontakt

Thomas Worobjew
People Attraction and Acquisition Expert
nca-de-recruiting@thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity.

The Friedrich Schiller University Jena is a dynamic and innovation-driven university centrally located in Germany. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Its scientific excellence is reflected in the profile areas Light - Life - Liberty, which provide pioneering insights and sustainable solutions for the society of tomorrow. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Institute of Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution at the Faculty of Biological Sciences seeks to fill the position of a

Doctoral Researcher in Viral Ecology (m/f/d)

commencing on 01 December 2026. We offer a part-time position (65%, 26 hours per week), with a fixed-term employment until 30 June 2030.

The DFG-funded Collaborative Research Centre 1768 “VirusREvolution: Decoding tools for virus research” is a highly ambitious research centre at Friedrich Schiller University with the joint goal to develop novel tools for virus discovery, characterisation, regulation, interaction, and visualisation (https://virusrevolution.uni-jena.de/). Its integrated research training group is educating doctoral researchers in a structured, interdisciplinary training program and invites applications for doctoral and postdoctoral researcher positions in various fields of research.
In this doctoral project “Do viruses exploit their quasispecies for host range evolution?”, you will investigate how host range and environmental conditions shape virus diversity and virus-host interactions in natural and experimentally manipulated microbial communities.
Conduct experimental work and analyses on virus-host interactions in soil and groundwater ecosystems, including host-range assays, environmental sampling, and targeted microcosm experiments
Analyse metagenomic and viromic data sets from soil and groundwater samples to identify broad- and narrow-host-range viruses to characterize their quasispecies characteristics
Participation in the Collaborative Research Centre VirusREvolution and close collaboration with the tandem project partner
Engage in regular discussions with other group and project members
Collaborate with BSc and MSc students working in associated projects
Publish papers and present your work at national and international scientific meetings

A highly motivated candidate with a Master of Science or equivalent degree in biology, microbiology, microbial ecology, virology, bioinformatics, or a related discipline
Experience in experimental microbiology, microbial ecology, and molecular biological methods; knowledge of sequencing-based bioinformatic approaches (metagenomics, viromics); experience with virus-host interactions are desirable.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving
Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team
Excellent skills in English are required, both written and spoken

Embedding in a cross-disciplinary, experienced research group and a large, ambitious research consortium
Affiliation to an Integrated Research Training Group, offering close support and a comprehensive education program for hard skills and transferable skills, supported by the Jena Graduate Academy
A family-friendly working environment with a variety of offers for families
University health promotion and a wide range of university sports activities
Remuneration based on the provisions of the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Federal States (TV-L) up to salary scale E13 - depending on the candidate’s personal qualifications -, including a special annual payment in accordance with the collective agreement.
30 days of vacation per calendar year plus two days off on December 24 and 31

Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d)

About Us
At betatron bio° we support our clients in developing sophisticated instruments and systems for the life science and diagnostics industries.

Our focus is on microfluidics, systems engineering, and AI - three disciplines we bring together into thoughtfully engineered and integrated systems, taking complex ideas from early concept through prototyping, validation, and pilot production.

To strategically expand our product and systems development in Münster, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) who will take ownership of the hardware and PCB design for complex measurement and control systems and see projects through from circuit design to final commissioning.

You will work in a highly specialized team with direct customer contact, international project assignments, and a short path from idea to implementation.
Design and develop PCB layouts for analytical instruments, medical-technology and diagnostic systems (analog, digital, mixed-signal) - from concept through to production-ready design
Hardware design including component selection, schematic capture, and design for manufacturability (DFM/DFT)
Develop and integrate firmware (embedded C/C++) for microcontroller-based measurement and control systems
Systematically test, debug, and commission electronic assemblies directly in the lab - hands-on and solution-oriented
System integration in close coordination with mechanical engineers, software developers, and customers
Technical documentation in line with regulatory requirements (IEC 60601, ISO 13485)
Help shape and continuously improve our development processes in a growing deep-tech startup
Must-haves

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or related technical field
At least 5+ years of professional experience in PCB design and hardware development - ideally in medtech, diagnostics, or industrial automation
Hands-on firmware development: embedded C/C++, microcontroller programming, interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, USB)
Hands-on experience with test instruments such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum analyzers including structured test execution, documentation, and reporting.
Strong ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive independent work.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and in German.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with microfluidic systems, lab-on-chip, or MEMS
Knowledge of EMC-compliant design and signal integrity analysis
Experience with ISO 13485 / IEC 60601 or comparable regulatory frameworks
Knowledge of Python or MATLAB for data analysis and test automation

Real impact: You'll help shape our product architecture directly - your designs go into market-relevant life science devices and directly influence our customers' strategies.

Variety, not routine: Projects spanning multiple customers, applications (diagnostics, single-cell analysis, sequencing, lab automation), and development phases - no two days alike.

Top-tier team: Work alongside internationally experienced founders, AI engineers, and systems engineers.

Growth & responsibility: A clear development path in a fast-growing company - help shape our processes, methods, and team.

Flexibility & culture: Flexible working hours, short decision-making paths, and a collaborative culture (innovation, excellence, collaboration)

Attractive package: Competitive compensation and a modern workplace in the heart of Münster.

About betatron bio°
At betatron bio°, we believe that great engineering happens when deep technical expertise meets speed, curiosity, and practical execution.

We combine deep microfluidics expertise with systems engineering excellence and AI-powered development tools - for results that speak for themselves.

If you want to work on real-world engineering problems with real-world impact, rather than maintaining an established product for years, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.employer_name: ISR International School on the Rhine GmbH
jobs.description:
Job Overview

ISR is accredited by the German authorities as an ‘Anerkannte Internationale Ergänzungsschule’ (International Supplementary School) and by the US accrediting agency Cognia (formerly known as AdvancED). ISR is an IB World School authorized to offer the IB Diploma Programme, and also offers Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) IGCSE courses. The school is a certified member of the Council of International Schools (CIS).

We wish to hire a dedicated and qualified full-time Admissions Employee (m/f/d) to join our dynamic educational institution from Autumn, 2026.

The successful candidate should be outgoing, confident in communicating with a wide range of people and able to build positive relationships quickly. Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset and a flexible approach to work are essential. A general understanding of different school systems and educational pathways would be an advantage.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

- Proactively contact interested families, provide relevant information and identify their individual needs.
- Manage and respond to all incoming enquiries from prospective families in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain accurate records in the admissions database and ensure consistent follow-up throughout the enquiry process.
- Conduct school tours during regular school operations and provide personalised guidance on ISR’s educational programs and school community.
- Support prospective families throughout the entire application and enrolment process.
- Represent ISR and present its educational concept at internal and external events.
- Attend and actively support the planning, coordination, and delivery of information sessions, open days, and Saturday Info Days.
- Build positive and trusting relationships with prospective families while ensuring a welcoming and professional experience at every stage

Qualifications

- Completed vocational training or a university degree.
- Previous experience in customer service, client advisory or sales.
- Excellent written and spoken English and German; additional language skills would be an advantage.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional, service-oriented and approachable manner.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexibility, reliability and strong organisational skills.
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with Veracross is an advantage

Job Benefits

We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rewarding working environment. In return, we offer a range of opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you are enthusiastic, highly motivated, enjoy a challenge, and believe you can contribute to the continued growth and development of our new ISR Elementary School Düsseldorf, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Then become a playmaker and join our team as Physical Security Specialist (f/m/d) at E.ON Digital Technology.

- Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of site security concepts across all business segments and locations

jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V.
jobs.description:
The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.

In the department Bioanalytics for the Multidimensional OMICS Data Analysis research group, we invite applications for a:

PhD Candidate (m/f/d)

This position is part of the Leibniz Science Campus “Cardio-Oncology Campus for Precision Medicine”, with focus on the analysis and development of biomarker profiles for the personalized assessment of cardiovascular risks associated with cancer therapy.

Non-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.

The full-time position is available immediately. It is fixed-termed and offered until September 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).
Analysis of phenotypic, microscopic, PET/MRI, MALDI-MSI, and LC-MS/MS data
Development of AI-based models for personalized risk assessment
Validation and application of model performance using established biomarkers and patient cohorts
Evaluation, analysis, and visualization of data
Documentation of laboratory work
Collaboration with project partners and regular presentation of results

M.Sc. or Diploma in bioinformatics or a comparable qualification
Extensive programming experience
Practical experience in machine learning and the application of large language models
Knowledge of OMICS and image data analysis
A willingness to engage in interdisciplinary scientific work, the ability to work in a team, an open-minded attitude, and a commitment to the work are required
Strong communication skills, organisational talent and a solution-oriented approach
Proficiency in MS Office

Training and scientific development opportunities in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team

The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops
A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about advancing compliance excellence in a global healthcare environment? Join our Human Pharma Compliance team and be a strategic business partner to Human Pharma stakeholders. You will contribute to key global compliance initiatives, help shape the evolution of Boehringer Ingelheim's healthcare compliance framework, and play an important role in steering our global Transparency Reporting & Disclosure framework. Through your work, you will help strengthen integrity and transparency while supporting sustainable business success across our global organization.
This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 2-3 days per week on site.
This position is limited for 1 year.
This position is part time eligible with 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As a strategic business partner, you will provide both strategic and operational compliance guidance to Human Pharma stakeholders. By understanding business priorities and assessing compliance considerations, you will help stakeholders navigate complex challenges, make informed decisions, and develop practical, risk-based solutions that enable sustainable business success.
- You will play a key role in operating and continuously evolving our global Transparency Reporting & Disclosure framework and other Human Pharma Compliance initiatives, collaborating with stakeholders across functions and countries to enhance transparency, strengthen compliance processes, and support consistent implementation across our global organization.
- You will contribute to the development and implementation of global Compliance Program elements, including policies, guidelines, training initiatives, monitoring activities, investigations, and risk assessments, in line with the overall compliance strategy.
- Working closely with Corporate Human Pharma colleagues and the global compliance network across countries, you will foster collaboration, share best practices, and help drive a consistent, risk-based, and effective compliance approach throughout the organization.

Requirements

The German Diabetes Center (DDZ), Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at Heinrich Heine University (HHU) Düsseldorf is an interdisciplinary research institute that integrates basic, translational and clinical research to improve the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of diabetes mellitus and its complications. The Institute for Clinical Biochemistry and Pathobiochemistry (Director: Prof. Dr. Hadi Al-Hasani) investigates the molecular mechanisms underlying insulin resistance, skeletal muscle metabolism and type 2 diabetes.

For a new research project, we are looking for a talented and highly motivated

Doctoral Student (PhD / Dr. rer. nat., m/f/div., E13 TV-L 65%)

to join our interdisciplinary research team investigating the molecular mechanisms by which repeated
cold exposure improves skeletal muscle insulin sensitivity.

Insulin resistance of skeletal muscle is a key feature in the development of type 2 diabetes, accounting for the majority of impaired postprandial glucose disposal. While lifestyle interventions such as exercise are well established, repeated cold exposure has recently emerged as a promising strategy to improve insulin sensitivity in humans, with reported improvements of up to 40%. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying these beneficial metabolic adaptations remain largely unknown.

The project aims to identify the signaling pathways responsible for cold-induced improvements in skeletal muscle insulin action. A particular focus will be placed on testing the hypothesis that mild cold-induced muscle activation ("micro-shivering"), rather than brown adipose tissue activation, mediates these metabolic benefits.

The project combines translational human studies with mechanistic investigations in mouse models and offers extensive training in state-of-the-art metabolic and molecular research techniques.
Proteomic analysis of human skeletal muscle biopsies obtained from cold acclimation studies to identify molecular signatures associated with improved insulin sensitivity.
Mechanistic studies in wild-type and UCP1-deficient mice to investigate the effects of cold exposure and muscle activation on glucose uptake and insulin action.
Functional characterization of established and novel regulators of skeletal muscle metabolism, including AMPK, GLUT4, Rac1 and newly identified candidate proteins.
Investigation of GLUT4 trafficking and insulin signaling using advanced molecular and cellular approaches.

The project offers training in:

Mass spectrometry-based proteomics
Mouse models of insulin resistance and metabolic disease
Indirect calorimetry and metabolic phenotyping
Glucose uptake assays in isolated skeletal muscle
Molecular biology techniques (Western blotting, qPCR, gene expression analyses)
Immunohistochemistry and skeletal muscle fibre typing

In vivo electroporation and functional gene manipulation
Fluorescence-based analysis of GLUT4 translocation

You hold (or are close to obtaining) a Master's degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Molecular Medicine, Physiology, Biomedical Sciences or a related discipline.
You have practical experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques such as Western blotting, qPCR and cell culture.
Experience with metabolic phenotyping, skeletal muscle biology, mouse models or proteomics is advantageous but not required.
You enjoy interdisciplinary research and are interested in combining human physiology with mechanistic laboratory studies.
You are highly motivated, curious, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.
You have an excellent command of written and spoken English.
